audience: equipment rental teams with an enabled EZRentOut company API token

useCases.title: Find overdue or available rental assets
useCases.text: Filter rental assets by availability or overdue status and inspect a selected asset and its booked dates.

useCases.title: Review a rental order
useCases.text: List orders, inspect the selected order and review its check-out and check-in history.

useCases.title: Review scheduled maintenance
useCases.text: List work orders and inspect their details before deciding what needs attention.

useCases.title: Record an external payment
useCases.text: Inspect an order and the available payment options, then record a payment already received through another channel. This records payment information and does not charge a card.
